description: WITHDRAWN. Superseded by disc-0004. The Level-0 promise this file protected — a CMS or wiki export with no ledger and no graph.nq can still publish a conforming discovery file — is unchanged and is now proved by disc-0004 against the RFC 9264 link set.
reason: Withdrawn at 1.0.0-rc.2 by D55 (V4-A A-09). This vector pinned the pre-D55 Level-0 relaxation: integrity_required false, omittable_integrity_members ["hashes.graph_nq","ledger_head"] and the vendor media type. Under D55 there is no structural difference between Levels: Level 0 is the same link set with every digest and agsc-* target attribute omitted. Superseded by disc-0004.
